_note: Constraint vocabulary. Literal definitions per value; enforcement is tight (unknown or disputed fails).

values.flat: sole raised under 1 in, no heel drop
values.low_platform: sole raised evenly under 2 in, heel drop at most 1 in
values.heeled: a heel or wedge with drop over 1 in, or any sole 2 in or more

values.patterned: print, check, stripe, animal, floral or multi

values.casual: everyday, lounge or athletic wear (drawstring or elastic lounge waists, sneakers, distressed denim)
values.smart: appropriate for a nice dinner (tailored trousers, clean flats and sandals)
